usage_notes: All figures are US data in USD from LocaliQ / WordStream by LocaliQ (USA TODAY Co.). They mix Google Ads and Microsoft Ads search campaigns, and LocaliQ says its 'averages' are medians. When quoting them in a proposal, cite them as 'US benchmark (WordStream by LocaliQ, 2026)'. Do not present them as Canadian or European figures. CPL is cost per lead (a call, form fill, chat or email), not cost per signed client. No verified Canada- or Europe-specific service-industry benchmark was found (see extra).

sources.publisher: WordStream by LocaliQ (USA TODAY Co, Inc.)
sources.title: Google Ads Benchmarks 2026: Competitive Data & Insights for Every Industry
sources.notes: Author Susie Marino, 'Last Updated: May 19, 2026'. About the data, verbatim: 'This report is based on a sample of 13,474 US-based search advertising campaigns running between Apr 1, 2025, and March 31, 2026. Each subcategory includes at minimum 52 unique active campaigns. "Averages" are technically median figures to account for outliers. All currency values are posted in USD.' Covers Google Ads and Microsoft Ads search campaigns from LocaliQ customers (mostly small and local businesses) across 23 industries. This is the newest edition; the caller asked for 2025 or 2024, and 2026 was published after that. Verified in a live browser on 2026-10-07.

medical.notes: Overall averages in the healthcare vertical report, verbatim: 'The overall average cost per click for healthcare search ads this year is $5.64.' 'The average conversion rate for healthcare search ads is currently 8.09%.' 'The average cost per lead for healthcare search ads is currently $66.02.'

beauty.quote: Beauty & Personal Care $4.62 (Average CPC) | 10.35% (Average CVR) | $39.25 (Average CPL)
beauty.notes: Covers salons and personal care. For med spas and aesthetics, the closest published rows are Dermatology and Plastic & Cosmetic Surgery in the healthcare report (below). No med-spa-specific benchmark was found. The report notes a big year-on-year swing for this category (CPL down 34.95%, CVR up 32.34%), so the figures may be volatile.

auto.quote: Automotive — Repair, Service & Parts $4.35 (Average CPC) | 15.51% (Average CVR) | $29.96 (Average CPL)
auto.notes: Dealers use a separate category, 'Automotive — For Sale': CPC $2.27, CVR 6.01%, CPL $44.26, CTR 8.28% (wordstream-2026, verified). The automotive vertical report (localiq-auto-2026, data Apr 2025 - Jun 2026) gives overall averages, verbatim: 'The average CPC for the automotive industry is $3.49.' 'The average conversion rate for automotive businesses is 9.21%.' 'The average CPL for automotive businesses is $33.12.'

real_estate.quote: Real Estate $3.22 (Average CPC) | 3.70% (Average CVR) | $102.51 (Average CPL). Also confirmed in localiq-realestate-2026: 'The overall average cost per lead for real estate search ads in 2026 is $102.51.'

finance_insurance.quote: Finance & Insurance $3.39 (Average CPC) | 2.64% (Average CVR) | $74.44 (Average CPL). Prose: 'Finance and Insurance (2.64%), Furniture (2.99%), and Career and Employment (3.05%) were the three industries with the lowest CVRs.'
finance_insurance.notes: One combined category. No separate accountant, mortgage-broker or insurance-broker rows were found in these reports. 'Business Services' (CPC $5.87, CVR 4.85%, CPL $93.69) may fit B2B accounting firms better.

travel.notes: The report says travel CPL fell 39.35% year on year, the biggest drop of any category.

all.quote: 'The average cost per click in Google Ads in 2026 is $5.42.' 'The average conversion rate in Google Ads in 2026 is 8.18%.' 'The average cost per lead in Google Ads in 2026 is $66.69.' 'The average click-through rate in Google Ads in 2026 is 6.64%.'
all.notes: Overall figures appear in prose only, not as table rows. The report says CPL fell for the first time in five years, and that conversion rate rose for 87% of industries.

extra.notes: No reputable published benchmark found. The LocaliQ/WordStream CPL measures leads (calls, forms, chats), not signed clients or booked patients.

extra.claim: Europe (Germany / Italy / Netherlands) Google Ads CPC benchmarks by service industry
extra.notes: No reputable country-by-industry benchmark for service businesses found. Smarter Ecommerce (smarter-ecommerce.com/en/smec-market-observer) publishes EU benchmarks, but only for ecommerce, so they do not apply to lawyers, dentists or trades. An agency guide (codedesign.org) shows inconsistent figures and was not used.
